ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces, roughly 1.5-2 cm each, golden-brown with darker caramelized edges and some charred spots, slightly glossy surface, firm and holding shape, scattered in a loose cluster on the left-center of a white square plate | 45
ITEM 2 | Crumbly white mass with rough, flaky, curd-like texture and small granules, matte with slight moisture, black speckles (cracked pepper) scattered on top, spread in an irregular heap about 5-6 cm across on the right side of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Small loose white crumbles, about 0.5 cm each, scattered near the white mass and along the plate edge, matte and dry | 5
